# Provider Admission Generated Solution

This temporary Generated Solution is the executable acceptance seam for the
provider-admission and absence harness.

The fixture selects PostgreSQL for relational persistence, Quartz for durable
jobs, and Azure Key Vault for secrets on the exact
`modular-monolith/net10.0/linux` matrix coordinate. Its provider-admission
record proves selected effects and the absence of every unselected catalog
provider. The provider-specific evidence records managed identity,
fail-fast/startup behavior, restart rotation, bounded freshness, outage
semantics, readiness preservation, and value-free observability. Invalid
selections are rejected before the generation callback can run.

The record is claim-free: catalog presence and Experimental evidence do not
create a Supported Capability claim.
